title: Pricing American Commodity Options Under the Schwartz Two-Factor Model Using the Alternating Direction Explicit (ADE) Method
abstract: arXiv:2610.21145v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This project investigates the valuation of American commodity options using the Schwartz two-factor model. We employ the double-sweep Alternating Direction Explicit (ADE) method, an unconditionally stable (for diffusion) finite difference scheme that provides the efficiency of explicit marching with the stability typically reserved for implicit methods, and compare it with the single-sweep alternating variant of Saul'yev. We derive the governing partial differential equation (PDE) and transform the semi-infinite domain into a rectangular computational domain. Furthermore, we apply Fichera theory to determine boundary conditions at the limits of the spot price. translated_title: 使用交替方向显式（ADE）方法在Schwartz双因子模型下定价美式商品期权
translated_abstract: 本项目研究使用Schwartz双因子模型对美式商品期权进行估值。我们采用双扫掠交替方向显式（ADE）方法，这是一种在扩散项上无条件稳定的有限差分格式，兼具显式推进的效率和通常只有隐式方法才具备的稳定性，并将其与Saul'yev的单扫掠交替变体进行比较。我们推导了控制偏微分方程（PDE），并将半无限域转换为矩形计算域。此外，我们应用Fichera理论来确定现货价格极限处的边界条件。最后，我们用C++实现了求解器，首先将结果与PDE的闭式解以及作为欧式期权的蒙特卡洛方法进行对比验证，然后施加美式提前行权约束，并与Longstaff-Schwartz蒙特卡洛方法进行基准比较，以分析数值精度。
tldr: 本文提出用双扫掠交替方向显式（ADE）有限差分方法在Schwartz双因子模型下定价美式商品期权，该方法兼具显式格式的高效率与隐式格式的无条件稳定性，并通过与闭式解、蒙特卡洛及Longstaff-Schwartz方法的对比验证了其数值精度。
en_tdlr: This paper prices American commodity options under the Schwartz two-factor model using the double-sweep Alternating Direction Explicit (ADE) method, which combines the efficiency of explicit schemes with unconditional stability, and validates its numerical accuracy against closed-form solutions, Monte Carlo, and Longstaff-Schwartz benchmarks.
